lines.text: Midst my journey to the Orbital Spire, I beheld strange Raptures, unlike all others seen before; fashioned, as it were, in the image of the human body, or rather the parts thereof. I had thought to find Raptures altered in part, but changed to a greater degree they could not have been.
Drawing nearer the Orbital Spire, I felt the earth tremble beneath my feet. What change could be in motion? What stirreth so?
Of the many replicas who did enter the Orbital Spire, there have been no tidings. I can do naught but pray they are well.
